sentences.text: Dated this the 5th day of June, 2025 An extent of 0.08 ares of land belonging to the petitioner was acquired for widening the Vellokkunnam - Post office junction road in terms of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ('2013 Act', for short).

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Petitioner preferred Ext.P1 claim statement, indicating the market value of the area and also the manner in which he was injuriously affected by the acquisition.
Ext .P2 is the award passed.
Petitioner filed Ext.P3 under Section 64 of the 2013 Act, seeking a reference.
The same is seen dismissed vide Ext.P4, stating untenable reasons.
Ext.P4 mentions that there is no request for reference in Ext.P1 claim statement.
A claim statement would not include a request for reference, since reference is sought for after passing the award.
Accordingly, Ext.P4 cannot be sustained, and the same is hereby set aside.

There will be a direction to the 1st respondent to consider Ext.P3, treating it as an application for reference under Section 64 of the 2013 Act, expeditiously, at any rate within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
Petitioner will produce a copy of this judgment to the 1st respondent for compliance.
The Writ Petition (Civil) is disposed of as above.

Sd/-
C. JAYACHANDRAN JUDGE TR ..4..
